page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6.26xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.re6 family. It is powered by 104 dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CL vCPUs and features 1536.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 14.77 GB of RAM per core. The instance runs on the KVM hypervisor, ensuring dedicated resource allocation for demanding enterprise workloads.

This server configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this instance, which is a standard configuration for secure, backend enterprise deployments.

Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio, this instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation and massive RAM capacity offer high resource density for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy data caching layers. The lack of local storage and GPU acceleration represents a clear tradeoff, positioning this server specifically for memory-bound, non-graphical enterprise applications that rely on network-attached storage.
